verdicts.reason: Both keep the broken 'CONS TRUC TION' headline from the original but set it small, on one line, with odd spaces in the word. Both also squash the offer into a tiny bottom row with the price placed after the CTA, so the headline and price no longer lead. A has its block of content off-centre (about a 100px left margin against roughly 50px on the right) and is mostly empty space: a small brick clipped by a hard edge that floats short of the canvas side. B makes better use of the canvas with consistent left alignment, but its brick is blown up until it looks pixelated and is still visibly clipped at x≈405.
